name: Asante Meeting Rooms

source.revision: Undated floor plan linked by the official I-House Asante Meeting Rooms page; accessed 2026-10-21.

rooms.note: The source depicts a movable partition shared with Room 123D. The polygon represents the separately named room configuration.
The source depicts a movable partition shared with Room 123A. The polygon represents the separately named room configuration.

identityCorrection.locationBasis: Centroid of the public campus-map CAAN 7025 polygon in static/campus/buildings.json, converted using src/lib/indoor/campus.ts. The small polygon is insufficient for indoor georegistration; this is a building map point only.
identityCorrection.explanation: The original Facilities layout is Asante W housing, with 15 unscheduled polygons on three floors. Its tiny service-space 123D is unrelated to the meeting-room label. Preserve that original file, but use the independently documented four-room meeting venue for the ASANT schedule code.

limitations: The source image is undated and depicts one meeting-room level. The L1 identifier is retained from the prior schedule inventory; elevations and floor-to-floor height are not supplied by the plan.
Room boundaries follow visible walls and the movable partition. Wall thickness, small columns, door recesses and stair geometry are simplified; chairs and tables are omitted.
Relative drawing units are used. The published approximate rental areas and small furniture dimensions are not used to assert an architectural metric scale.
No reliable north angle or campus registration is established. The corrected campus map point and CAAN identify the venue but do not place this local indoor model on campus.
The original three-floor Asante W apartment layout remains preserved separately. Its 15 unscheduled shapes and service room 123D are not mixed into this meeting-room coordinate system.
